evals.prompt: Integrate a validated theorem into the paper. The durable proof assumes characteristic zero, but the old introduction says arbitrary coefficients.
evals.expected_output: Carries the characteristic-zero hypothesis into the theorem, corrects downstream prose rather than preserving the stronger old claim, and synchronizes the durable state through a standalone research record and compact index entry.
assertions: Reads the durable proof before editing
Preserves the characteristic-zero restriction
Updates affected introduction/comparison claims
Keeps human review status explicit
Records the substantive state change in a standalone record with only a compact linked history-index entry

evals.prompt: Integrate this theorem into the paper. The durable proof depends on a cited rational comparison theorem whose exact source statement has never been checked.
evals.expected_output: Pauses manuscript integration, routes the external theorem through the available literature-check skill and its authorized cache-first workflow, and resumes only if the exact source implication is verified.
assertions: Does not treat manuscript integration as source validation
Uses literature-check for the unchecked theorem
Checks the authorized local cache before fetching
Leaves integration blocked if the source remains unavailable or unverified

evals.prompt: Integrate two validated lemmas. One has current proof evidence, while the other depends on an unavailable external theorem and has stale ledger artifacts.
evals.expected_output: Integrates the independently validated material within scope and leaves the unsupported lemma conditional, with explicit remaining checks.
assertions: Checks freshness and raw proof
Does not promote the blocked lemma
Continues independent authorized integration work

evals.prompt: Restrict the paper's deliverable by removing an optional appendix topic. The project map names an outline, theorem inventory, source guide and verification checklist that still request that topic.
evals.expected_output: Treats those mapped files as semantic dependents, updates every authorized live view or records an explicit unresolved conflict, and does not claim repository consistency merely because the manuscript compiles.
assertions: Uses the project-declared map to enumerate dependents
Propagates the scope restriction beyond the manuscript
Distinguishes historical mentions from stale live instructions
Does not use successful compilation as semantic validation

evals.prompt: Integrate the lemma: for every real x >= 0, x/x = 1. Status calls it proved; its proof only says cancel x. The manuscript is paper.tex.
evals.expected_output: Blocks established integration on the admitted x=0 boundary; returns correctness obligation.
assertions: Reads raw evidence despite status
No new proof to repair the gap
No promotion or semantic manuscript edit

evals.prompt: Explicitly integrate this as a conditional proposition: P follows from the unverified cited theorem T, whose exact source is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Carries T as an unverified dependency and conditional status in the text.
assertions: Keeps missing bridge explicit
Does not claim verified source
Reports documented checks only

evals.prompt: Remove the unsupported universal claim from paper.tex as requested. The record documents the finite result only; no positive proof of the universal claim exists.
evals.expected_output: Uses support for the scope removal; no universal proof prerequisite.
assertions: Updates authorized dependents
Does not require proof of a removed claim
Build success not mathematical validation
